anchor_texts: Attrition is measured on a night-by-night basis, with shortfalls calculated by comparing actual rooms occupied to the block size on each night of the event period.

Group shall receive no credit toward its block commitment for nights on which the Hotel sells out all available rooms in the Hotel, and occupancy on such nights shall be deemed to have satisfied the threshold regardless of the actual number of rooms occupied from the block.

anchor_texts: Should Group cancel this agreement at any time after execution by the parties, Group shall be liable to the Hotel for liquidated damages calculated as a percentage of gross room revenue that would have been earned by the Hotel for all guest rooms for all nights within the event period of April 12-16, 2027, based upon the negotiated room rate and the full room block size.

anchor_texts: Group shall deposit with the Hotel the sum of $30,000.00 as security for damage to Hotel premises and furnishings caused by Group, its members, guests, invitees, or agents during the event period of August 2-7, 2027 and any ancillary dates directly related to Group's occupancy.
